label: PF Backlog 552
title: Process: exclude the legacy Dashboard scope from PF review checks + suspend backend<->dashboard reciprocity (retain, retire later)
body:
## Problem / why
The legacy dashboard leaked into PF work/reviews: the backend<->dashboard reciprocity REVIEW rule flagged
every open PF item missing a `dashboard_impact` (25 + 14 warnings), and the `project:ProductForge-Dashboard`
scope (146 open items) showed up in cross-scope advisory checks (dedup). The dashboard backlog is legacy and
will be redesigned separately, so this noise must be excluded now.

## Goal & value
Dashboard (design + instance) declared LEGACY: excluded from PF review/advisory checks, RETAINED in the
backlog (never deleted), with retirement tracked for later. Fully reversible via one config flag.

## In scope
- `config/pf-review-scope.json` (owner core/backlog.py): `legacy_scopes` + `dashboard_reciprocity.active`.
- `core/backlog.py`: `legacy_scopes()`, `dashboard_reciprocity_active()`, `_is_legacy_scope()`; exclusion in
  `duplicate_pairs()`, `api_impact_warnings()`, `reciprocity_warnings()`.
- `scripts/dev/wired_audit.py`: advisory audits honor it and report the exclusion.
- `AGENTS.md` + `docs/REVIEW-MODEL.md`: note the suspension.

## Out of scope
- Deleting/archiving the dashboard items (retained); redesign of the new dashboard (future).

## Acceptance criteria (G/W/T)
- Given `dashboard_reciprocity.active=false`, when `wired_audit` runs, then reciprocity is skipped (0 warnings).
- Given a legacy scope, when duplicate/api_impact audits run, then it is excluded.
- Given the flag flips back to true, then the reciprocity rule re-activates (reversible).

## Data model (what is stored, where, owner)
`config/pf-review-scope.json` (kind=config, scope=global, owner core/backlog.py).

## API contract
No API change (internal process/config). needs_api=false.

## Dependencies & links (by id)
Suspends the rule from BI-0082 (dashboard reciprocity). Related: BI-PF-1202 (security epic, unaffected).

## Verification / test plan
`wired_audit` exit 0; reciprocity 39->0; dedup dashboard pairs removed; legacy scope flag reversibility.

## Retirement
REVISIT later: redesign the dashboard, then retire/delete the `project:ProductForge-Dashboard` scope and the
frozen `dashboard/server.py`, and flip `dashboard_reciprocity.active` back on.
